item.title: Ransomware Attack: What to Do in the First Hour
item.description:
A ransomware attack can begin with a malicious email, compromised account, or vulnerable system and quickly turn into encrypted files, inaccessible servers, and serious business disruption.

When a ransom note appears or important files suddenly become unreadable, the first actions you take can have a major impact on the extent of the damage and your chances of recovering the data.
